name: 2026 Forms W-2 request.eml
subject: HANGS General Contracting 2026 Forms W-2
body:
Hi,

Attached are the 2026 earnings by employee, the payroll ledger by pay run and the 2026 company vehicle use log from our safety manager. Please prepare the 2026 Forms W-2 and the W-3 for us to review; we plan to e-file them with the SSA and mail the employee copies by the deadline.

The earnings file is the final year-end export from the payroll system. The Q1 to Q3 Forms 941 are filed; the Q4 941 is prepared and we will file it together with the W-2s.

Two things I am not sure about. Alicia Castellano (E-1101) started on December 7 and has applied for her Social Security card; it has not arrived yet. And I do not think payroll ever picked up the personal use of the two pickups in the vehicle log.

Thanks,
Dana Whitfield
Controller, HANGS General Contracting LP
